rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Widgets carry semantics, not just emphasis — match the widget to MEANING.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 79: `> **Worth keeping?** Ask Claude to save the access-surface map and the STRIDE walk to your repo's docs/ directory, next to the ADR, before you clear.` — this beat is exactly the rule's third bucket ("Neither [Session/HOX] but must not be missed → Note": real analysis is lost on `/clear` if skipped). But the marker text used is `**Worth keeping?**`, not the canonical `**Note**` string the renderer keys on (`site/layouts/curriculum.js` matches literal marker words per `widgets.md`) — so it renders as a plain bold-lead blockquote with no widget chrome at all, not the teal must-not-miss Note treatment the content's stakes call for.
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Re-mark as `**Note** Ask Claude to save the access-surface map and the STRIDE walk...` so the renderer actually applies Note's teal/must-not-miss chrome; reconcile with the sibling slides-class finding on this same line (which reads it as a plain CTA lead to de-bold) before landing the edit.
